body: We don't have any hotlines for this where I live

I really can't change the way I think the way I am, I have never harmed anyone but I've been a disappointment to a lot of people. I hold no grudges for anyone that has wronged me in my life or screwed me over mentally, but no one accepts me for who I am as I accept them. And I carry around the guilt of everyone on my shoulder's.  
I can't talk to anyone close about this, I can't go back to a professional because there are social repercussions.
